phase_title: Phase 15-7/15-8 測定ワークフロー実行可否の最終判定レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 17-2（Phase 15-7 実行可否判定）、Phase 17-3（Phase 15-8 実行可否判定）、Phase 17-4（判定結果証跡固定・改ざん検出）、Phase 17-5（PROCEED/HOLD/HALT 処理フロー）、Phase 17-6（実行前最終停止条件）のすべての層の結果を統合し、Phase 15-7 と Phase 15-8 の最終的な測定ワークフロー実行可否を判定するレポートを設計する。9 つの判定シナリオすべてに対応し、各シナリオでの最終判定（PROCEED/HOLD/HALT）、権限者判定結果、実行許可条件を記録する。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of final judgment report structure and synthesis logic only, no actual final judgment synthesis or report generation yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 17-7 final judgment report is design-only; no actual judgment synthesis or report generation occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual final judgment synthesis occurs.

final_judgment_report_purpose.purpose: Synthesize all upstream phase results (Phase 17-2, 17-3, 17-4, 17-5, 17-6) into a single, comprehensive final judgment report answering: 'Can Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows execute safely and completely?'
judgment_scope: Phase 17-2 Phase 15-7 execution feasibility result (PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT)
Phase 17-3 Phase 15-8 execution feasibility result (PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT)
Phase 17-4 judgment result lock status (LOCKED, or TAMPERING_DETECTED)
Phase 17-5 decision handling outcome (PROCEED authorization issued, or HOLD pending authority decision, or HALT blocking condition)
Phase 17-6 execution precondition verification status (ALL_PRECONDITIONS_PASSED, or specific precondition_FAILED)

inputs: phase_17_4_judgment_lock_status: LOCKED | TAMPERING_DETECTED (for both Phase 17-2 and 17-3)

algorithm_step_2_check_lock_integrity.action: Verify both Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 judgment lock status
algorithm_step_2_check_lock_integrity.logic: IF (phase_17_4_lock_status_for_17_2 == TAMPERING_DETECTED) OR (phase_17_4_lock_status_for_17_3 == TAMPERING_DETECTED) THEN result_integrity_compromised = TRUE
algorithm_step_2_check_lock_integrity.if_integrity_compromised: Final result must be HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_MEASUREMENT; forensic investigation required; skip remaining synthesis steps

logic: IF phase_17_2_overall_result == PROCEED AND phase_17_5_decision_outcome == AUTHORIZATION_ISSUED AND phase_17_6_precondition_status == ALL_PRECONDITIONS_PASSED THEN phase15_7_final_result = PROCEED
IF phase_17_2_overall_result == HOLD OR phase_17_5_decision_outcome == PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION THEN phase15_7_final_result = HOLD
IF phase_17_2_overall_result == HALT OR phase_17_5_decision_outcome == HALT_BLOCKING_GATE OR phase_17_6_precondition_status == PRECONDITION_FAILED THEN phase15_7_final_result = HALT
IF phase_17_3_overall_result == PROCEED AND phase_17_5_decision_outcome == AUTHORIZATION_ISSUED AND phase_17_6_precondition_status == ALL_PRECONDITIONS_PASSED THEN phase15_8_final_result = PROCEED
IF phase_17_3_overall_result == HOLD OR phase_17_5_decision_outcome == PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION THEN phase15_8_final_result = HOLD
IF phase_17_3_overall_result == HALT OR phase_17_5_decision_outcome == HALT_BLOCKING_GATE OR phase_17_6_precondition_status == PRECONDITION_FAILED THEN phase15_8_final_result = HALT

algorithm_step_5_synthesize_overall_resu.action: Determine overall Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement execution feasibility

report_header.report_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when final judgment synthesis completed
report_header.report_purpose: Final synthesis of all Phase 17 layers for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement execution feasibility

phase_17_2_result.gate_summary: Brief summary of which gates passed/failed
phase_17_2_result.overall_feasibility: Overall Phase 15-7 execution feasibility from Phase 17-2

phase_17_3_result.gate_summary: Brief summary of which gates passed/failed
phase_17_3_result.overall_feasibility: Overall Phase 15-8 execution feasibility from Phase 17-3

phase_17_4_lock_integrity.integrity_summary: Both locks valid or tampering detected

phase_17_5_decision_handling.decision_summary: Whether authority approved, deferred, or halted execution

phase_17_6_preconditions.precondition_summary: All execution preconditions met or specific failures identified

lock_integrity_analysis.tampering_detected: If tampering found, document: which lock (17-2 or 17-3), forensic evidence, recommended action (halt and investigate)
lock_integrity_analysis.lock_status_decision_impact: If tampering, final result must be HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_MEASUREMENT regardless of upstream results

final_phase15_7_synthesis.phase15_7_summary: Narrative explanation of why Phase 15-7 received PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT result

final_phase15_8_synthesis.phase15_8_summary: Narrative explanation of why Phase 15-8 received PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT result

overall_execution_feasibility_synthesis.overall_summary: Comprehensive narrative of Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement execution feasibility and next required actions

measurement_execution_scenario.scenario: Which of 9 upstream scenarios applies (e.g., BOTH_PROCEED, PROCEED_HALT, HALT_HOLD, etc.)
measurement_execution_scenario.scenario_handling: Per Phase 17-5 scenario definitions, how should execution be authorized or halted
measurement_execution_scenario.combined_execution_recommendation: Can both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 execute? Sequential or concurrent? Or halted?

next_action_recommendation.if_overall_proceed: Issue Phase 17-8 execution authorization; proceed to Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 measurement execution
next_action_recommendation.if_overall_hold: Await authority decision on readiness gaps; escalate to authority approval committee; upon decision, either proceed or trigger remediation
next_action_recommendation.if_overall_halt: Stop all measurement execution planning; initiate forensic investigation; escalate to authority for remediation approval

audit_trail_reference.reference_to_phase17_4_audit_trail: Link to Phase 17-4 audit trail documenting all lock events and tampering detections
audit_trail_reference.reference_to_phase17_5_decision_log: Link to Phase 17-5 decision handling log documenting authority decisions (WAIVE, REQUEST_IMPROVEMENT, etc.)
audit_trail_reference.reference_to_phase17_6_precondition_log: Link to Phase 17-6 precondition verification results

report_footer.signature_status: Will be signed by authority after Phase 17-7 review; signature added in Phase 17-8

nine_judgment_scenarios_mapping.scenario_documentation: Final judgment results for all 9 upstream scenarios

scenario_1_both_proceed.next_action: Issue Phase 17-8 authorization; execute both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8

scenario_2_proceed_hold.next_action: Phase 15-7 can proceed; Phase 15-8 awaits authority decision on readiness gap waiver or remediation

scenario_3_proceed_halt.next_action: Phase 15-7 can proceed; Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze Phase 15-8 blocking gate failure and trigger remediation approval

scenario_4_hold_proceed.next_action: Phase 15-8 can proceed; Phase 15-7 awaits authority decision on readiness gap waiver or remediation

scenario_5_both_hold.next_action: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 awaits authority decision; escalate both readiness gaps for coordinated decision

scenario_6_hold_halt.next_action: Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze blocking gate failure and trigger remediation approval; Phase 15-7 decision independent

scenario_7_halt_proceed.next_action: Phase 15-7 blocked; analyze blocking gate failure and trigger remediation approval; Phase 15-8 decision independent

scenario_8_both_halt.next_action: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze both blocking gates; escalate comprehensive remediation

scenario_9_halt_hold.next_action: Phase 15-7 blocked; Phase 15-8 awaits authority decision; Phase 15-7 blocking gate failure takes priority
